page.overview:
What is Rocks Pirates?

The Rocks Pirates were a legendary pirate crew led by Rocks D. Xebec. Considered to be the most dangerous and strongest pirate crew of their time, they dominated the seas before the rise of Gol D. Roger, meeting their downfall 38 years ago during the God Valley Incident.

The crew's Jolly Roger is depicted as a burning red skull with flames that resemble two horns. It is shown as the O for "Rocks" on the sail of the ship.

Rocks D. Xebec was already active as an independent pirate at least 56 years ago, when he invaded the Levely. Afterwards, through the repeated use of the Davy Back Fight, he acquired Edward Newgate, Shiki, Buckingham Stussy, Don Marlon, Ochoku, and Ganzui as subordinates at least 48 years ago. Rocks repeatedly attempted to convince King Harald to join his yet-to-be-founded crew, but the giant refused every time. In contrast, Harald's son Loki wished to join the crew, but Rocks repeatedly declined since he was not interested in having a mere child on his crew.

At least 44 years ago, now with a fully formed crew, Rocks had added to its ranks John, Charlotte Linlin, Streusen, Barbel, and Kaidou. Kyo later joined the crew after their takeover of Hachinosu was complete, with Gloriosa joining soon after leaving the Kuja Pirates.
